name: Durotar Tiger Fur
summary: Across the Echo Isles off Durotar's southeastern coast, Durotar Tiger Fur helps the growing Darkspear settlement endure. The trolls make blankets, tents, and armor from the pelts.

sections.title: A Vital Resource for the Darkspear
sections.body: In Sen'jin Village, the Darkspear must make scarce supplies last. So they let local tigers thrive until their needs call for a cull. Trolls cure the thick hides into goods their settlement needs, including armor and warm blankets for changing seasonal weather.

sections.title: Hunting the Echo Isles
sections.body: The Echo Isles lie south of Durotar, across open water. The Darkspear once called the islands home, until the witch doctor Zalazane drove them out. Hunters face danger from Zalazane's thralls and from tigers among the thick foliage. Experienced hunters such as Vel'rin Fang speak of spending entire days motionless in the jungle brush to secure a single clean kill.

faq.q: Where are Durotar tiger furs obtained?
faq.answer: Hunters collect Durotar tiger fur from tigers across the Echo Isles, off Durotar's southeastern coast.

faq.q: Why do the trolls of Sen'jin Village need these furs?
faq.answer: Vel'rin Fang gathers fur for the growing Darkspear settlement. The trolls use it to make blankets, tents, and protective leather armor against seasonal weather.

faq.q: Why don't the trolls overhunt the tigers?
faq.answer: The Darkspear let the tiger population thrive and cull only when their growing community's needs strain supplies of shelter and clothing.

angles.text: For the Darkspear, tiger hides mean survival in Sen'jin Village. They also recall the painful loss of their homeland on the Echo Isles.
As a Hunter, stalking tigers in the Echo Isles calls for patience and camouflage. The hunt echoes classic troll hunting rites as you ambush the stealthy island predators.
